policy.duplicate_rule: If another live claim exists for the same claim_key, do not inspect or mutate that work item; return SKIP_DUPLICATE.
policy.completed_rule: If the same claim_key is already COMPLETED and the repository subject revision is unchanged, do not repeat the audit.
policy.optimistic_lock: Every mutation must use the current GitHub blob SHA. On SHA conflict, refetch the registry and re-evaluate before retrying.
policy.revision_guard: Before material writes, re-check the repository head. If it moved, abandon or supersede the old claim and claim the new revision.
policy.canonical_boundary: Claims coordinate A-session research only and never change B/C/D canonical standards.
